certificate.caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in Section 11.1.2 of the Security Policy
certificate.description: The Luna T7 Cryptographic Module from Thales Trusted Cyber Technologies (TCT) is a tamper-resistant Hardware Security Module (HSM) implemented in a multi-chip embedded hardware module for FIPS 140-3 validated key security, typically used in enterprise-class tamper-resistant server appliances. Thales TCT's Luna HSMs are developed, manufactured, sold, and supported in the United States.
